name: Redo
description: Redo gives AI assistants direct access to your entire commerce operations stack. Manage returns and exchanges, recover abandoned carts, optimize checkout, track orders, automate support workflows, manage inventory and fulfillment, and surface customer insights all through natural language. Connect your AI tools to the systems powering your brand so teams can move faster, reduce manual work, increase revenue, and create better customer experiences across the full e-commerce lifecycle.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Redo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Redo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.getredo.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Redo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Redo lists 36 MCP tools, including approve_return, ask_redo, close_return, create_draft_return, create_return_comment, delete_return_tag, edit_custom_analytics_report, generate_custom_analytics_report, get_automation, get_automation_performance, get_automation_step_configuration, and get_automation_step_performance.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Redo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Redo in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Redo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Redo is developed by Redo. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
